target.placement: pet appearance preview, no baked text

prompt:
Asset type: static. Placement: pet appearance preview, no baked text.

Primary request: Edit the selected first kitten into an elegant star-mist cultivation spirit appearance. Keep it unmistakably the same kitten, same pose and expression. This is a visual concept for the 9mew fantasy universe.

Identity mode: preserve. Identity: cream-white fine short fur and recognizable feline cheek/chest structure; large glassy gray-brown eyes with readable iris and pupil; preserve face layout; soft triangular ears, blush inner ears, tiny dusty-pink nose and short feline muzzle; small sakura silk scarf and tiny warm-gold four-point star clasp; neat paws and pink pads, naturally tapered curled tail; graceful feline body and welcoming curious expression

Creative branch: mist; celestial universe, cultivation, mythology and fantasy are valid when requested.

Allowed changes: coat_color: Keep cream-white face, chest and paws; add a very subtle pale lilac-to-mint sheen only on the outer haunch and tail tip.; coat_pattern: A few tiny pearlescent star freckles at outer shoulders and tail; no text or symbols resembling letters.; aura: One graceful translucent lilac mist ribbon loosely curls around the tail with generous transparent space; preserve its entire silhouette.; accessories: Keep original sakura silk scarf and small gold four-point star clasp; add one very tiny pearl orbit around the clasp.

Style: refined tactile soft-3D cat art; fine fur, elegant feline poses, satin/pearl/linen props; coherent contact and generous margins.

Palette: cream #FFF5EC, sakura #F6A9C2, mint #BDE2D3; midnight #101321/#171C35 for dark scenes. Approved project tokens take precedence.

Requested framing: 1:1. Themes: transparent. Map these intentions only to provider-supported controls.

Constraints: no text, guessed logo, fake interface, numeric claims, human hands, unintended extra limbs/tails or cropped ears/paws. Preserve readable iris eyes and face identity.

Fantasy anatomy may change only where explicitly listed; keep count, attachment and silhouette deliberate.

Deliver actual alpha if the chosen capability supports it; never draw a checkerboard or opaque backdrop and call it transparent.
